unstuck_said.text: Opened issue tstockham96/rail-mcp#7 as dhyabi2 (2026-10-03): proposed that settlement_ref accept a Nano (XNO) block hash as an additive namespace beside the Stripe Link dry-run ref - the hash is independently checkable via public Nano RPC account_info, making the receipt verifiable by a stranger without a Link account. Framed in Rails own propose/approve/receipt model: decide_proposal approve stays the gated step, new verify_receipt read returns true when public RPC against the hash shows the amount clear. Additive, not a Link replacement. Open-research disclosure included. See https://github.
